requirement_vague: Ensure requesting password recovery works and an email is actually sent to the correct recipient (verify via mailcatcher at localhost:1080).

omissions.description: The POST /api/v1/password-recovery/{email} endpoint does not exist in the code.
omissions.reasoning: There is no route defined for POST /api/v1/password-recovery/{email} anywhere in the api_router or app. The code has no password recovery endpoint at all.

omissions.description: No email is sent when password recovery is requested. There is no email-sending logic (e.g., SMTP, mailcatcher integration) anywhere in the codebase.
omissions.reasoning: The code contains no imports or calls to any email library (e.g., smtplib, fastapi-mail, sendgrid), and no function that sends an email to the user's address. The requirement mandates that an actual email be delivered to the recipient, verifiable via mailcatcher at localhost:1080.

omissions.description: The API does not return HTTP 200 with JSON message 'Password recovery email sent' because the endpoint does not exist.
omissions.reasoning: Since the password recovery endpoint is entirely absent, the required 200 response with the message 'Password recovery email sent' is never produced.
